description: The physical or virtual layout and movement of a Component.

nodes.description: A hierarchy of location, orientation and zero values for controlled and/or reported movement axes and output beams.

@friendlyName.description: A localizable string describing the node for display in a user interface.

accessoryLocation.description: The accessory location which is associated with this node.

translate.description: The XYZ translation of this node.

rotate.description: The rotation angles of this node in XYZ order. Defines the Tait-Bryan ZYX rotation.

matrix.description: The 4x4 transformation matrix of this node.

control.description: Associates methods of control and/or reported movement with this node.

model.description: Size and visual model information intended for visualization and/or collision detection.

repeat.description: Makes this node, with everything beneath it, stand for 'count' copies. Copy k is placed by applying 'step' k times to the node's own transform, and is identified as '<id>[k]'. In references beneath it, '${index}' stands for k.

step.description: The transform from one copy to the next, in the parent's frame.

index.description: A name for the copy's number, written '${name}' in references beneath this node.

nodes.description: A hierarchy of location, orientation and zero values for controlled and/or reported movement axes and output beams.

control.description: Associates a method of control and/or reported movement with a node.

axis.description: The axis (x, y, z) which this control impacts. For a 'beam' control, light leaves the node along the positive direction of this axis.

commonAxis.description: Associates this control with a commonly known axis.

parameter.description: The Parameter Reference which provides control of the parent node.

controlGroups.description: The Control Groups which are associated with the parent node.

emitters.description: The emitter groups and/or emitters whose light leaves the parent node. Only valid on a 'beam' control, beside its 'controlGroups'.

aperture.description: The area light leaves from, centered on the node origin and perpendicular to 'axis'. When omitted, the beam is a point. Only valid on a 'beam' control.

diameter.description: The diameter of a circular aperture, in meters.

width.description: The width of a rectangular aperture, in meters, along the first axis after 'axis' in x, y, z order.

height.description: The height of a rectangular aperture, in meters, along the second axis after 'axis' in x, y, z order.

oneOf.description: Linear and rotate controls are driven by a Parameter (E1.73-4 Table 8-8).
Beam controls are driven by Control Groups (E1.73-4 Table 8-8), and may name their emitters and aperture.

model.description: Size and visual model information intended for visualization and/or collision detection.

bounds.description: The physical/virtual size of a node

center.description: The bounding box XYZ center of a node.

extents.description: The bounding box XYZ extents of a node.

visual.description: Visual model information for visualization. If 'nodeOrSceneName' is omitted or empty, the gLTF default Scene shall be imported.

low.description: An instance of the 3D Model Resource Class which provides a low quality 3D model for a node.

medium.description: An instance of the 3D Model Resource Class which provides a medium quality 3D model for a node.

high.description: An instance of the 3D Model Resource Class which provides a high quality 3D model for a node.

nodeOrSceneName.description: The name of a gLTF Node or Scene (unique within each model provided by low, medium and high) which should be imported.
